# Hotspotsystem

HotspotSystem provides public Wi-Fi hotspot management and billing services for businesses.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hotspotsystem/.

## Actions

- **Generate Voucher (v1)**: Generate an access voucher on the fly.
- **List MAC Transactions by Location** (read-only): List MAC transactions by location.
- **List Paid Transactions by Location** (read-only): List paid transactions by location.
- **List Social Transactions by Location** (read-only): List social transactions by location.
- **List Voucher Transactions** (read-only): List voucher transactions globally across all locations.
- **List Voucher Transactions by Location** (read-only): List voucher transactions by location.
- **List Vouchers** (read-only): List the resource owner's vouchers across all locations.
- **Misc Ping** (read-only): Perform health check against the HotspotSystem API.
- **Vouchers List by Location** (read-only): List vouchers by location.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List customers.
- **List Customers by Location** (read-only): List customers by location.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List the resource owner's locations.
- **List MAC Transactions** (read-only): List MAC-based transactions.
- **List Social Transactions** (read-only): List social transactions.
- **List Subscribers** (read-only): List newsletter subscribers.
- **List Subscribers by Location** (read-only): List subscribers by location.
